messages.author: a798ae8eb83fb9a2
messages.subject: Spatial-temporal model with slm
parts:
Hello! 

I want to conduct a spatial-temporal model with "slm" model, but it continues to report an error "Error: all(dim(args.slm$W) == c(slm.n, slm.n)) is not TRUE".

Here are my test scripts with Ohio lung cancer data.

remove(list=ls())
my.dir <- paste(getwd(),"/",sep="")

require(INLA)
inla.setOption(scale.model.default=FALSE)

require(splancs)
require(sp)
require(fields)
require(maptools)
require(lattice)
require(abind)
require(spdep)

###################################################
### Code for Section 7.1
###################################################
# You neeed a folder called "Ohio Lung Cancer" inside your working directory (my.dir)
# with the data downloaded from
# https://sites.google.com/a/r-inla.org/stbook/datasets

data <- read.csv(paste(my.dir,"OhioRespMort.csv",sep=""))
ohio <- readShapePoly(paste(my.dir,"tl_2010_39_county00",sep=""))
county1 <- data$county
#Ohio.adj <- paste(my.dir,"Ohio.graph",sep="")
Ohio.adj <- poly2nb(ohio)
Ohio.mat <- nb2mat(Ohio.adj)

e1 <- eigen(Ohio.mat)$values
re.idx1 <- which(abs(Im(e1)) < 1e-6)
rho.max1 <- 1/max(Re(e1[re.idx1]))
rho.min1 <- 1/min(Re(e1[re.idx1]))
rho1 <- mean(c(rho.min1, rho.max1))

mmatrix <- as.matrix(rep(0, nrow(data)))   #zero matrix

## Precision matrix for beta coeffients' prior
betaprec <- .0001
Q.beta = Diagonal(n=ncol(mmatrix), betaprec)

## Priors on the hyperparameters
hyper = list(
  prec = list(
    prior = "loggamma",
    param = c(0.01, 0.01)),
  rho = list(
    initial=0,
    prior = "logitbeta",
    param = c(1,1)))

formula.par <- y ~ 1 +  f(county, model="slm",
                          args.slm=list(
                            rho.min = rho.min1,
                            rho.max = rho.max1,
                            W=Ohio.mat,
                            X=mmatrix,
                            Q.beta=Q.beta),
                          hyper=hyper) + 
  f(county1,year,model="iid", constr=TRUE) + year

model.par <- inla(formula.par,family="poisson",data=data,E=E, 
                  control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE), 
                  control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE))

round(model.par$summary.fixed[,1:5],3)

Do you know how to solve this problem?

I am looking forward to your early reply.

Best,
Xiaojun
